# Standalone analyses

## BayesPrism

```bash
iobrpy bayesprism \
  --input results/PRJNA482620/03-tpm/tpm_matrix.csv \
  --output results/PRJNA482620/08-bayesprism \
  --threads 4
```

The output directory contains:

```text
results/PRJNA482620/08-bayesprism/
├── theta.csv
├── theta_cv.csv
└── Z_tumor.csv
```

## TME clustering

```bash
mkdir -p results/PRJNA482620/09-tme-cluster

iobrpy tme_cluster \
  --input results/PRJNA482620/05-tme/cibersort_results.csv \
  --output results/PRJNA482620/09-tme-cluster/tme_clusters.csv \
  --features 1:22 \
  --min_nc 2 \
  --max_nc 5 \
  --print_result
```

```text
ID,cluster,<selected features>
<sample_1>,TME1,...
<sample_2>,TME2,...
```

## HLA typing

```bash
iobrpy hla_typing \
  -b results/PRJNA482620/02-star \
  -r hg38 \
  -o results/PRJNA482620/10-hla \
  -j 4 \
  -u 1
```

The output directory contains:

```text
results/PRJNA482620/10-hla/
├── ExtractHLAread/<sample>/
├── SpecHLA/<sample>/hla.result.txt
└── hla_result_merged.txt
```
